summary: Use runtime dispatch when the callee is an arbitrary JS value whose callability, proxy behavior, or call target cannot be statically resolved.

target.notes: Runtime dispatch must perform IsCallable/[[Call]], preserve Reference this binding, support callable Proxy/bound/function objects, and throw TypeError for non-callables.

caveats: C# dynamic is not a JS semantics implementation.
Property-reference vs value-call distinction still affects this.
references: ECMAScript 2026 Language Specification Call abstract operation / Proxy [[Call]]
